notes.subject: khesed
notes.rationale: D2: khesed i stap olsem tok Hibru, no 'marimari' tasol

notes.subject: grav na Abadon
notes.rationale: askim i tok: i no gat man long Seol i ken tokautim gutpela pasin bilong Yahwe

notes.subject: Abadon
notes.rationale: em i nem bilong ples, no 'destruction' — Tok Pisin i givim tupela

translation: Bai ol tokautim ⟨i⟩ khesed bilong yu long grav? O stret pasin bilong yu long Abadon, ples bilong lus olgeta?

tokens.gloss: long Abadon, ples bilong lus olgeta
